speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a breast mass; to help me understand your situation, please tell me how long you have noticed this lump and if it has changed in size or texture recently.

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Cancer (Invasive Ductal Carcinoma)

The rapid growth of a mass in a 48-year-old woman over just four weeks is highly concerning for malignancy. I will proceed with imaging to evaluate the extent of the lesion. REQUEST IMAGES: Mammogram and Breast_Ultrasound.
